mapper.sql: select c.content_id, c.content_code, c.codeword, c.title, c.content_kind, c.account_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.platform, c.topic, c.topic_ref, c.playbook_code, c.degree, cast(c.countries as text) as countries, c.body, cast(c.hashtags as text) as hashtags, cast(c.cards as text) as cards, c.hook_tool, c.tool_link, cast(c.citations as text) as citations, c.ai_generated, c.agent_code, c.ai_call_id, c.requires_confirm, c.sampled, c.gate_status, cast(c.gate_result as text) as gate_result, c.gate_by, c.gate_time, c.confirm_by, c.confirm_time, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from abr_content c left join abr_channel_account a on a.account_id = c.account_id
mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from abr_content where codeword = #{codeword} and status <> 'archived' and content_id <> #{excludeId})
mapper.insert: insert into abr_content (content_code, codeword, title, content_kind, account_id, topic, topic_ref, playbook_code, degree, countries, body, hashtags, cards, hook_tool, tool_link, citations, ai_generated, agent_code, ai_call_id, requires_confirm, sampled, gate_status, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{contentCode}, #{codeword}, #{title}, #{contentKind}, #{accountId}, coalesce(#{topic}, ''), #{topicRef}, #{playbookCode}, #{degree}, cast(coalesce(#{countries}, '[]') as jsonb), coalesce(#{body}, ''), cast(coalesce(#{hashtags}, '[]') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{cards}, '[]') as jsonb), #{hookTool}, coalesce(#{toolLink}, ''), cast(coalesce(#{citations}, '[]') as jsonb), coalesce(#{aiGenerated}, 'N'), #{agentCode}, #{aiCallId}, coalesce(#{requiresConfirm}, 'N'), coalesce(#{sampled}, 'N'), 'pending', 'draft', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_content set codeword = #{codeword}, title = #{title}, content_kind = #{contentKind}, account_id = #{accountId}, topic = coalesce(#{topic}, ''), topic_ref = #{topicRef}, playbook_code = #{playbookCode}, degree = #{degree}, countries = cast(coalesce(#{countries}, '[]') as jsonb), body = coalesce(#{body}, ''), hashtags = cast(coalesce(#{hashtags}, '[]') as jsonb), cards = cast(coalesce(#{cards}, '[]') as jsonb), hook_tool = #{hookTool}, tool_link = coalesce(#{toolLink}, ''), citations = cast(coalesce(#{citations}, '[]') as jsonb), gate_status = #{gateStatus}, gate_result = cast(#{gateResult} as jsonb), gate_by = coalesce(#{gateBy}, ''), gate_time = #{gateTime}, confirm_by = coalesce(#{confirmBy}, ''), confirm_time = #{confirmTime}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where content_id = #{contentId}

update abr_content set gate_status = #{gateStatus}, gate_result = cast(#{gateResult} as jsonb), gate_by = coalesce(#{gateBy}, ''), gate_time = now(), status = #{status}, update_by = coalesce(#{gateBy}, ''), update_time = now() where content_id = #{contentId}
update abr_content set status = 'ready', confirm_by = #{confirmBy}, confirm_time = now(), update_by = #{confirmBy}, update_time = now() where content_id = #{contentId} and status = 'pending_confirm'
update abr_content set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where content_id = #{contentId}
